subject: Tree Committee Ordinance
overview: The Committee of the Whole met to discuss and amend a proposed ordinance establishing a municipal tree committee. The committee approved the amended draft and referred it to the full City Council.

items.title: Tree Committee Ordinance
items.summary: The committee approved and referred to the City Council an amended draft of the Tree Committee Ordinance, updating its membership criteria, term lengths, and advisory duties to align with department of public works operations.
